# GDB/MI from run_until's own sessions through ST-LINK_gdbserver in attach mode,
# 2026-10-03: a NUCLEO-H743ZI running h7_vars and an STM32F407 running f4_vars,
# both from RAM, built by tools/hwcheck. "> " marks each command run_until sent;
# the lines after it are everything GDB printed until the next command.
## h7-unmapped: a breakpoint at 0x60000000, where nothing answers on the H7
> -gdb-set mi-async on
=thread-group-added,id="i1"
~"Reading symbols from h7_vars.elf...\n"
(gdb) 
^done
> -gdb-set confirm off
(gdb) 
^done
> -gdb-set pagination off
(gdb) 
^done
> -target-select extended-remote localhost:61234
(gdb) 
=thread-group-started,id="i1",pid="42000"
=thread-created,id="1",group-id="i1"
~"0x240000e2 in delay (n=2000000) at debug_target.c:48\n"
&"warning: 48\tdebug_target.c: No such file or directory\n"
*stopped,frame={addr="0x240000e2",func="delay",args=[{name="n",value="2000000"}],file="debug_target.c",fullname="images/debug_target.c",line="48",arch="armv7e-m"},thread-id="1",stopped-threads="all",core="0"
^connected
> -data-read-memory-bytes 0x24000000 64
(gdb) 
^done,memory=[{begin="0x24000000",offset="0x00000000",end="0x24000040",contents="00000824930000244100002441000024410000244100002441000024000000000000000000000000000000004100002441000024000000004100002441000024"}]
> -data-read-memory-bytes 0xE0002000 4
(gdb) 
^done,memory=[{begin="0xe0002000",offset="0x00000000",end="0xe0002004",contents="81000010"}]
> -data-read-memory-bytes 0xE0001000 4
(gdb) 
^done,memory=[{begin="0xe0001000",offset="0x00000000",end="0xe0001004",contents="01000040"}]
> -break-insert "*0x60000000"
(gdb) 
^done,bkpt={number="1",type="breakpoint",disp="keep",enabled="y",addr="0x60000000",thread-groups=["i1"],times="0",original-location="*0x60000000"}
> -interpreter-exec console "info mem"
(gdb) 
~"Using memory regions provided by the target.\n"
~"Num Enb Low Addr   High Addr  Attrs \n"
~"0   y  \t0x00000000 0x08000000 rw nocache \n"
~"1   y  \t0x08000000 0x08200000 flash blocksize 0x400 nocache \n"
~"2   y  \t0x08200000 0xffffffff rw nocache \n"
^done
> -exec-continue
(gdb) 
^running
*running,thread-id="all"
&"Warning:\n"
&"Cannot insert breakpoint 1.\n"
&"Cannot access memory at address 0x60000000\n"
&"\n"
^error,msg="Command aborted."
> -break-delete
(gdb) 
^done
> -target-detach
(gdb) 
=thread-exited,id="1",group-id="i1"
=thread-group-exited,id="i1"
~"[Inferior 1 (Remote target) detached]\n"
^done
> -gdb-exit
(gdb) 
^exit
